title: Public Utilities Act
verified_how: Register index entry 'Public Utilities Act', consolidation date December 6, 2018. Cover page prints 'PUBLIC UTILITIES ACT / R.S.N.W.T. 1988,c.24(Supp.)' (French: 'LOI SUR LES ENTREPRISES DE SERVICE PUBLIC / L.R.T.N.-O. 1988, ch. 24 (Suppl.)'), amended through S.N.W.T. 2011,c.8 and later chapters, each with in-force dates (e.g. R.S.N.W.T. 1988,c.110(Supp.) in force September 1, 1991; S.N.W.T. 2007,c.9 in force June 30, 2007, SI-004-2007). Standard office-consolidation notice; not marked repealed. Administering department per the October 13, 2025 table: Executive and Indigenous Affairs.
notes: Establishes the NWT Public Utilities Board and its jurisdiction over the rates, tolls and charges of electricity and other regulated utilities - i.e. what a customer may lawfully be billed. The NWT Power Corporation itself is constituted by the Northwest Territories Power Corporation Act.
